summary: Keep reconciliation-drift-incident-listener healthy by acknowledging non-trading infrastructure incidents without reconciliation delivery, bounding listener ticks by a configurable time budget, and reporting backlog size and progress in health state.

incident_context.symptom: Dev deploy run 37719887861 failed with 'required component(s) unhealthy or unknown: reconciliation-drift-incident-listener: health=unhealthy'. The listener container healthcheck kept returning 'health is not ready: status=starting ticks=0' while sitting in socket poll to reconciliation-drift-svc:8102 with an 18-item backlog of infrastructure incidents (binding infra-subject-*).
incident_context.root_cause: Two compounding defects: (1) Infrastructure incidents (non_trading_infrastructure_incident=true) were being delivered to reconciliation-drift despite having no trading binding to reconcile. (2) Without a tick time budget, serial synchronous retries across the 18 items against a slow/busy single-process uvicorn service exceeded the healthcheck timeout budget; client timeout resulted in result=None, calling record_delivery_failure() and moving updated_at while the server completed later with 201, leaving backlog at 18 and ticks at 0.
incident_context.resolution: Incident listener identifies non-trading infrastructure incidents and acknowledges them immediately without reconciliation delivery; reconciliation-drift service answers fast not_applicable if called; run_tick() is bounded by tick_budget_seconds (default 30s) so ticks always complete and increment ticks >= 1; health state records backlog_count and last_progress_at.

acceptance_verification.ac1_infrastructure_incident_bypass_and_f: passed: listener acknowledges infra-subject-* and non_trading_infrastructure_incident=true incidents without HTTP delivery, removing them from backlog; reconciliation-drift endpoint returns fast not_applicable (status=ok, skipped=true, not_applicable=true, no store evaluation).
acceptance_verification.ac2_tick_bounded_by_time_budget_and_prog: passed: run_tick() checks tick_deadline before processing items; health state initializes and updates backlog_count and last_progress_at; tick finishes within budget, setting status=ok and ticks >= 1 so healthcheck passes.
acceptance_verification.ac3_reproduction_and_mechanism_analysis: passed: documented in reproduction_analysis.md; verified mechanism of client timeout vs server completion and ruled out removal/persistence defects in IncidentListenerState.
acceptance_verification.ac4_backlog_18_recovery_test: passed: test_backlog_of_18_infrastructure_incidents_finishes_within_budget_and_health_becomes_ready verifies that 18 infrastructure incidents are drained in milliseconds without calling slow reconciliation stub, and health becomes ready.
acceptance_verification.ac5_clean_code_and_line_budget: passed: 71 net production lines added across incident_listener.py (+68) and main.py (+3), well within the 80 net line limit. Standard formatting with no compression.
acceptance_verification.ac6_hosted_track: external_wait: awaiting next automatic dev pair release to pass exact_component_deployment gate for reconciliation-drift-incident-listener.
